assertions/ILT.COMMON.CHANGE.APPROVAL.PR.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.COMMON.CHANGE.APPROVAL.PRODUCTION_APPROVED
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: "Production change approved: its digest by a security reviewer, or its run"
  remediation: Have an independent security reviewer approve the change's digest, or get the run approved.
spec:
  change_type: null
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
  when:
    path: organization_scope.environment.production
    equal: true
  assert:
    any:
      - exists:
          in: approvals
          where:
            all:
              - path: item.status
                equal: approved
              - path: item.subject.kind
                equal: change
              - path: item.subject.digest
                equal:
                  path: change.digest
              - path: item.roles
                contains: security
              - path: item.independence
                equal: independent
      - exists:
          in: approvals
          where:
            all:
              - path: item.status
                equal: approved
              - path: item.subject.kind
                equal: run
              - path: item.subject.id
                equal:
                  path: run.id

assertions/ILT.COMMON.CHANGE.SOURCE.COMM.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.COMMON.CHANGE.SOURCE.COMMITS_REVIEWED
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: Every commit the change ships since its review starting point was merged through a pull request with a qualifying approval
  remediation: Merge every commit through a pull request approved on its final head, before the merge, by a person who can write to the repository and wrote none of it; run the change from, or build the image from, the commit Iltero verified; have an administrator set a review starting point when none fits.
spec:
  change_type: null
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
  assert:
    path: commit_review.outcome
    equal: reviewed

assertions/ILT.IAC.CHANGE.APPROVAL.APPRO.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.CHANGE.APPROVAL.APPROVED_AFTER_PLAN_STAGE_RECORD_ACCEPTED
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The apply job was approved after the plan stage's record was accepted, and not before, where an approval of the apply job is required
  remediation: Require a reviewer for the apply job in the CI system, run the apply job again, and approve the new run after the plan stage's record is accepted.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
  when:
    all:
      - path: apply_job_facts.flow
        not_equal: plan_and_apply_in_one_job
      - path: apply_job_facts.approval_requirement.required
        equal: true
  assert:
    all:
      - path: apply_job_timing.approvals_given_before_plan_stage_record_accepted
        equal: 0
      - path: apply_job_timing.approvals_given_after_plan_stage_record_accepted
        greater_than_or_equal: 1

assertions/ILT.IAC.CHANGE.APPROVAL.SENSI.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.CHANGE.APPROVAL.SENSITIVE_CHANGE_APPROVED
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: "IAM, network or key change approved: its digest by a security reviewer, or its run"
  remediation: Have an independent security reviewer approve the change's digest, or get the run approved.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
    resources:
      - provider: aws
        kinds:
          - iam_access_key
          - iam_group_membership
          - iam_group_policy
          - iam_identity_provider
          - iam_policy
          - iam_policy_attachment
          - iam_role
          - iam_role_policy
          - iam_user_policy
          - kms_grant
          - kms_key
          - kms_key_policy
          - network_acl
          - network_acl_rule
          - security_group
          - security_group_rule
  assert:
    any:
      - exists:
          in: approvals
          where:
            all:
              - path: item.status
                equal: approved
              - path: item.subject.kind
                equal: change
              - path: item.subject.digest
                equal:
                  path: change.digest
              - path: item.roles
                contains: security
              - path: item.independence
                equal: independent
      - exists:
          in: approvals
          where:
            all:
              - path: item.status
                equal: approved
              - path: item.subject.kind
                equal: run
              - path: item.subject.id
                equal:
                  path: run.id

assertions/ILT.IAC.CHANGE.CONTENT.EVALUA.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.CHANGE.CONTENT.EVALUATED_PLAN_IS_PINNED_PLAN
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The evaluated plan is the plan the run is held to
  remediation: Apply the plan the run is held to, or open a new run for another plan.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
  assert:
    path: apply_job_facts.pinned_plan_digest
    equal:
      path: plan.digest

assertions/ILT.IAC.CHANGE.CONTENT.RECEIV.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.CHANGE.CONTENT.RECEIVED_PLAN_FILE_MATCHES_EVALUATED_PLAN_FILE
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The apply job reported the saved plan file the plan stage evaluated, by its digest
  remediation: Give the apply job the saved plan file the plan stage evaluated.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
  when:
    path: apply_job_facts.flow
    not_equal: plan_and_apply_in_one_job
  assert:
    path: apply_job_facts.received_plan_file_digest
    equal:
      path: plan.artifact_digest

assertions/ILT.IAC.CHANGE.CONTENT.RENDER.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.CHANGE.CONTENT.RENDERED_PLAN_MATCHES_EVALUATED_PLAN
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The plan the apply job reports it rendered from its saved plan file is the plan the plan stage evaluated
  remediation: Give the apply job the saved plan file the plan stage evaluated, and the plan it renders.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
  when:
    path: apply_job_facts.flow
    not_equal: plan_and_apply_in_one_job
  assert:
    all:
      - path: apply_job_facts.rendered_plan.digest
        equal:
          path: plan.digest
      - path: apply_job_facts.rendered_plan.digest_version
        equal:
          path: plan.digest_version
      - path: apply_job_facts.rendered_plan.tool
        equal:
          path: plan.tool

assertions/ILT.IAC.CHANGE.CONTENT.REPLAN.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.CHANGE.CONTENT.REPLAN_HAS_SAME_ACTIONS_AS_EVALUATED_PLAN
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The re-plan the apply job reports plans the same actions on the same resources as the plan the plan stage evaluated
  remediation: Plan the change again in a new run, review the new plan, and approve its apply job.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
  when:
    path: apply_job_facts.flow
    not_equal: plan_and_apply_in_one_job
  assert:
    path: replan_check.differences_count
    equal: 0

assertions/ILT.IAC.CHANGE.TIMING.PLAN_AG.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.CHANGE.TIMING.PLAN_AGE_WITHIN_LIMIT
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The plan was no older than its plan age limit when the server issued the apply job's facts
  remediation: Plan the change again, and apply it within the plan age limit.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: pre_deploy
  target:
    kind: change
  assert:
    path: apply_job_timing.plan_age_seconds
    less_than_or_equal:
      path: apply_job_facts.plan_age_limit.seconds

assertions/ILT.IAC.DEPLOYMENT.CONTENT.AP.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.DEPLOYMENT.CONTENT.APPLIED_PLAN_MATCHES_EVALUATED_PLAN
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: The applied plan is the evaluated plan
  remediation: Apply the plan that was evaluated, or evaluate the plan you apply.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: post_deploy
  target:
    kind: deployment
  assert:
    all:
      - path: deployment.plan.digest
        equal:
          path: plan.digest
      - path: deployment.plan.artifact_digest
        equal:
          path: plan.artifact_digest
      - path: deployment.plan.artifact_digest_source
        equal:
          path: plan.artifact_digest_source

assertions/ILT.IAC.DEPLOYMENT.DRIFT.NO_D.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.DEPLOYMENT.DRIFT.NO_DRIFT_AFTER_APPLY
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: No resource of the state differed from the apply in the latest reading
  remediation: Find what changed each differing resource since the apply, then apply the reviewed configuration again.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: post_verify
  target:
    kind: deployment
  assert:
    path: drift_check.differences_count
    equal: 0

assertions/ILT.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.S3.PUBLI.text:
apiVersion: iltero.com/v1
kind: TechnicalAssertion
metadata:
  id: ILT.IAC.RESOURCE.AWS.S3.PUBLIC_ACCESS_BLOCKED
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: S3 bucket blocks all public access
  remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block for the bucket that sets all four settings to true.
spec:
  change_type: iac_change
  stage: plan
  target:
    kind: resource
    resources:
      - tool: terraform
        provider: aws
        resource_types: [aws_s3_bucket]
  assert:
    exists:
      in: resource.related
      where:
        all:
          - path: item.relation
            equal: configures
          - path: item.type
            equal: aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block
          - path: item.resource.after.block_public_acls
            equal: true
          - path: item.resource.after.ignore_public_acls
            equal: true
          - path: item.resource.after.block_public_policy
            equal: true
          - path: item.resource.after.restrict_public_buckets
            equal: true
